notes.title: Summoner's Mess is available now.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm very happy to announce that Summoner's Mess is now available on Steam.

As a solo developer this is a huge achievement for me, my first commercial game available to everyone. I'm scared and joyful at the same time.

I really hope you enjoy the game, and I wish this is the first of many short little games.

Thanks for everything.

Cheers,
Èric
